metadata.description: Decision-driven engineering skills and support tooling — lightweight, verifiable workflows.

plugins.name: fiber
plugins.description: Agent skills for decision-driven engineering — grilling, spec and tracer-bullet ticket flows, TDD, code review, and domain modelling. Verifiable loops, not guesswork.

plugins.name: spin
plugins.description: Standalone utilities and conveniences for Claude Code — the everyday skills the fiber workflow doesn't cover, installable alongside it.

plugins.name: wt
plugins.description: Git worktree mechanics for the b3oy1 stack — the throwaway/destination layer convention, worktree home management, and the lazygit diff-viewing helper. Install when a repo uses .fiber/worktrees/; skip it for plain feature-branch repos.
